text:
Maria: heads-up — I'm out in ~20m and want to swap primary to Alex. No active Sev1 on my radar but please confirm. Runbook for handoff: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff (see 'Primary handoff checklist').

incident-bot: [AUTO] No active incidents assigned to #eng-oncall. Last page: 1779121200 — resolved. Pager stats: 0 open, 1 closed in last 24h.

Alex: ack, I can take primary. I'll run the pager test and confirm handoff. Any ongoing customer impact or items I should watch?

Sam: I'll stay secondary until 02:00 UTC. Heads-up — there's a scheduled deploy at 01:30 UTC, recommend enabling routing fallback for the first 15m. I can cover the first 30m after swap.

Maria: quick checklist I'm running through before I leave:
- transfer Slack DMs for alert channels and DM-based pages
- add rotation note to calendar event
- export active traces from Sentry and link to ticket
- post this thread and link runbook
- mute noisy non-critical monitors

Maria: runbook snippet (copy/paste):
```
# Primary handoff checklist
1. Confirm you have the primary pager on and can receive pages
2. Post handoff message in #eng-oncall with confirmation and coverage window
3. Transfer ownership of any active incidents (update assignee + incident timeline)
4. Verify notification routing: GET /api/admin/pager/status -> primary/secondary
5. Run a pager test: POST /api/admin/pager/test?target=primary
6. Confirm Sentry/Alerting inbox has no open Sev1/2
```

Alex: ran the pager test just now — test page received ✅. Verified routing endpoint returned primary=alex secondary=sam. Checked Sentry: no open sev2/1. I added an oncall note: "Alex primary — coverage until 02:00 UTC (Sam secondary)".

Maria: leaving now. @Alex you have the keys. I muted some low-priority alerts before leaving. :wave: If anything escalates, follow the runbook.

Alex: got it — primary accepted. Phone is on, Slack notifications unmuted. If a Sev1 page hits: pager -> Slack -> phone call -> escalation per runbook. I'll post any incidents into this thread. :phone:

Sam: noted. If the deploy creates noise I'll triage the first 30m then hand back if needed. :thumbsup:

Alex: closing handoff — primary swap acknowledged. Thanks Maria.
